Dog Appears to Greet Intruder, Pestering Them to Play

Video footage from San Diego shows a golden retriever appearing to greet a home intruder, instead of barking. The dog reportedly brought a toy to the intruder and seemed to pester them to play during the break-in. The incident has led to the dog being described as the 'world's worst guard dog'.
